title: {{term:coordinates}} and {{term:translation}}
summary: Plot points from their coordinates, find the missing vertex of a shape, and translate shapes on a grid.
guide: The grid has two axes: the x-axis across and the y-axis up. They meet at the {{term:origin}}, (0, 0). Coordinates are written (x, y): the first number says how far across, the second how far up. (4, 2) means 4 across, then 2 up.
The classic mistake is swapping the two numbers. A saying that helps: "along the corridor, then up the stairs" — across first, then up.

In a {{term:translation}} every point of the shape slides the same distance in the same direction. The shape does not turn, flip or change size. Moving 4 right and 2 up adds 4 to every x-coordinate and 2 to every y-coordinate.

engine.letters: A B C D E F G H I J
engine.instruction-draw: Tap the vertices, then the first one again.

plot-point.title: Plot a point
plot-point.hint: The first number is x: go 4 across from the origin. The second number is y: then go 2 up.
plot-point.success: Well done! A is at (4, 2): 4 across and 2 up.
plot-point.model: No. (2, 4) means 2 across and 4 up, which is a different point. The order matters: the first number is always across (x), the second is always up (y).

feedback.empty: Tap the grid to plot a point.
feedback.swapped: You swapped x and y. The first number (4) is across: go 4 across first, then 2 up.
feedback.too-many: Plot just one point. Tap a point again to remove it.
feedback.wrong-point: That point is not (4, 2). Start at the origin: 4 across, then 2 up.

fourth-vertex.title: The fourth vertex
fourth-vertex.prompt: A{{vec:1,1}}, B{{vec:4,1}} and C{{vec:5,3}} are three vertices of the {{term:parallelogram}} ABCD. Predict the coordinates of D, then plot D.
fourth-vertex.hint: In a parallelogram, opposite sides are parallel and the same length. How far across is it from A to B? Go the same distance back from C.
fourth-vertex.success: Well done! D is at (2, 3). Side DC is 3 long and flat, just like AB.
fourth-vertex.why: How did you find D's coordinates without counting from the origin?
fourth-vertex.model: From A to B is 3 to the right. The opposite side must match, so from C go 3 to the left: x = 5 − 3 = 2, and y stays 3. So D is (2, 3).

feedback.empty: Tap the grid to plot D.
feedback.right-corner: With D there, side AD is upright but side BC slopes, so they are not parallel. DC must be 3 long, like AB.
feedback.one-side: With D there, side DC is only 1 long, but the opposite side AB is 3 long. Opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal.
feedback.swapped: You swapped x and y. The first number is across.
feedback.wrong-point: That point does not make a parallelogram. DC must be parallel to AB and the same length.

translate-triangle.title: Translate the triangle
translate-triangle.prompt: Translate triangle ABC 4 squares right and 2 squares up, and draw the new triangle. The coordinates of the last vertex you tapped show under the grid.
translate-triangle.hint: Move each vertex on its own. A(1, 1) goes to (5, 3). Do the same for B and C.
translate-triangle.success: Well done! Every vertex moved 4 right and 2 up. Same shape, new place.
translate-triangle.why: What happened to the coordinates of each vertex?
translate-triangle.model: Each x-coordinate went up by 4 and each y-coordinate by 2. A(1, 1) became (5, 3) and C(1, 3) became (5, 5). The side lengths and angles did not change.

feedback.empty: Tap the grid to draw the new triangle.
feedback.swapped: You moved 2 right and 4 up. You swapped the numbers: 4 right and 2 up.
feedback.not-image: That is not triangle ABC translated. Move each vertex 4 right and 2 up. The shape must not turn or change size.

describe-translation.title: Describe the translation
describe-translation.prompt: Drag the green shape so it fits exactly on the dashed outline. Then describe how far it moved, and which way.
describe-translation.hint: Follow one vertex. How many squares left and how many up is it from the green shape's bottom-left corner to the outline's?
describe-translation.success: Well done! The shape moved 4 squares left and 3 squares up.
describe-translation.why: How would you describe this translation?
describe-translation.model: 4 squares left and 3 squares up. Every vertex moved the same: (5, 1) went to (1, 4). Going left makes the x-coordinate 4 smaller, going up makes the y-coordinate 3 bigger.

feedback.wrong-place: The shape is not on the outline yet. Count for one vertex: how many squares left, how many up?
feedback.swapped: That moved 3 across and 4 up or down: the other way round. It is 4 left and 3 up.
